stations.title: Ifan
stations.say: Which dogs need the big scales?

stations.title: animals
stations.text: Every animal, light or heavy, in one table.
stations.note: Every query returns all of them.

captions: Ifan wants to know which dogs are too heavy for the small scales.
Every query still returns every animal, so he would have to read them all.
You keep only the rows that match a condition, with AND, OR and NOT, in four tasks.
Now Ifan gets a short list of exactly the dogs he asked about.
Same table, the right rows. Each question gets only its own answer.
